assessments.name: Active engagement
assessments.description: Students are expected to contribute proactively during live classes throughout the semester. Exceptional in-class participation that enhances collaborative learning may also be recognised.

assessments.name: Peer review feedback and content reflection
assessments.description: Via online discussion boards, students provide constructive written feedback on other students' work and, using visual communication tools, reflect on the main points of the course content.

assessments.name: Introduction video
assessments.description: Students submit a short introductory video before the first live class to introduce themselves to the teaching team and classmates, helping establish an engaging learning community from the beginning of the unit.

assessments.name: Early feedback task
assessments.description: Students complete an online diagnostic quiz comprising multiple-choice and self-reflection questions to assess their understanding of the unit structure and identify any early learning or support needs.

assessments.name: Innovation research review + presentation pitch
assessments.description: Teams of students describe, critically analyse, and present their assessment on a recent study related to project innovation management. The presentations are pre-recorded and submitted online prior to live classes.

assessments.name: Secure in-semester multiple-choice test
assessments.description: Students complete a supervised multiple-choice test assessing their understanding of the key concepts, principles and methodologies covered during the first half of the unit.

assessments.name: Innovation case study + presentation pitch
assessments.description: Teams of students conduct a case study of a real innovation management project. The presentations are pre-recorded and submitted online prior to live classes.
